excerpts.author: donschoe
excerpts.content:
Does anyone have an opinion on simplifying the genesis time formula?

https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/issues/1849

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content:
I'm broadly of the same opinion as you, although I have a slightly higher preference for option 0 for marketing reasons (gives us more time between genesis being defined and  chainstart to get the word out, gives us a "well-known" time for genesis).

And I'd hope we aren't going to go through too many more testnet restarts (<10?) before we have a long-lived multi-client testnet and don't have to worry about it on a day-to-day basis.

excerpts.author: mpetrunic
excerpts.content: I'm also in favor of option 2 makes much more sense for setting local dev networks since you can set delay to 0 for network to start whenever you have enough validators

excerpts.author: nishant0
excerpts.content: Wouldnt that be the same as we have now, if we set the genesis delay to zero ? It would also start immediately

excerpts.author: nishant0
excerpts.content: I would favour 0 just for the reason that it would be best to avoid any breaking changes except for critical bug fixes now, but 2 is fine too if everyone else wants to go in that direction
